title: kbingest map copies MSBuild error text carrying evaluated values into its notes
goal: A failed dotnet msbuild call's stderr no longer carries repository-evaluated values into the map's notes: the note names the MSBuild error code and project without the message text (or the text is shape-checked), so a property function such as ReadAllText feeding an Import path cannot put a local file's content into a note that only the leak scan guards; a test named kbingest_map_dotnet_note_values with a planted MSB4019 message proves it (sprint SP-xourq2gj review finding 2)
